sentences.text: Heard learned counsel Sri.Sanjay S. Katageri, Sri.Sangamesh S. Ghulappanavar, Sri.S.V.Yaji and Sri.R.R.Mane.
2. First respondent being owner of the Tata Sumo vehicle bearing No.MH-12/JA-4031 served with the appeal notice and remained absent.
3. Appeal by the claimants seeking enhancement of compensation awarded in MVC No.2320/2005 dated 30.11.2011 on the file of Fast Track court at Athani.

Claimant being the injured laid a claim in respect of accidental injuries sustained by him in the road traffic accident that occurred on 22.11.2003 at about 7.15 p.m. involving Tata Sumo bearing No.MH-12/JA-4031 and goods truck bearing No.KA-17/A-3098.
4.

On contest, tribunal granted compensation of Rs.50,000/- with interest at 6% p.a. and ordered that 50% of the award amount is recoverable from the owner NC: 2024:KHC-D:802 of the Tata Sumo vehicle as charge sheet is filed against the driver of the tata sumo vehicle and said vehicle did not possess valid insurance policy as on the date of accident.
5. Being aggrieved by the quantum of compensation, claimant is in appeal.
6. Sri

.Sangamesh S. Gulappanavar, learned counsel for the appellant vehemently contended that the tribunal has awarded meager amount of compensation for the accidental injuries sustained by claimant and sought for allowing the appeal.
7. Per contra, learned counsel Sri.S.V.Yaji, Sri.Sanjay Katageri and R.R.Mane supports the impugned judgment.

8. Taking note of the fact that the injuries sustained by the claimant has been properly established by examining the treated doctor, this court is of the considered opinion that enhancement of compensation in a a sum of Rs.75,000/- globally is just and proper; especially taking note of the fact that the accident is of the year 2005, NC: 2024:KHC-D:802 enhancing Rs.75,000/- would meet the ends of justice instead of enhancement on each and every heads.

9. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Appeal is allowed in part.
ii) As against compensation of Rs.50,000/-
awarded by the tribunal, claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.1,25,000/-(Rs.50,000/-
+Rs.75,000/- enhanced globally) with interest at 6% p.a. recoverable from the owner of the Tata Sumo bearing No.MH-12/JA-4031.
